honors.title: Facebook Melbourne Hackathon 1st Place
honors.description:
Moji is a website tool enabling end users to react to any web page (article, video, etc) with an emoji.
This was built for two demographics: end users, and website owners who might want to gauge reactions and other statistics on their sites and pages.
